title: [Feature]: Enable RCCL on Strix Halo gfx1151
body: Migrated from ROCm/rccl#2118. The requester wanted RCCL enabled on gfx1151 to test a Thunderbolt 5 / USB4 v2 RCCL plugin and distribute llama.cpp/lemonade-server work.

comments.text: Asked whether the gfx1151 PR would make it work; reported trying Thunderbolt networking on Framework Desktop and observing an apparent limit. This is community commentary, not AMD validation.
Discussed TB4/USB4 expectations, MINISFORUM MS-S1 hardware, and a basic device-to-device driver. This is requester commentary, not validated RCCL support.
Acknowledged contributors after the gfx1151 enablement was merged.
